translations.web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
translations.bsb: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
translations.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
translations.asv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
